Nadia, I found five ticket numbers for Vantorre Group (the parent) across #strategic-pod, #inc-vtg-hartford and Moss's Strategic digests.

| Ticket | What it is | Source |
|---|---|---|
| **#8841** (also written #PD-8841) | Allentown/Newark gate kiosk problems; see the caveat below | #strategic-pod, 1 Jul 2026 (Gideon says he closed it). Moss digests of 27 Apr 2026, 4 May 2026 (listed as still open) and 30 Sep 2026 (Mateo's ticket, escalated to platform engineering) |
| **#PD-4418** | `Carrier_Dwell_Summary` export drops timestamps for Dock Door 9 at the 04:00 shift changeover | Moss digest, 15 Sep 2025 |
| **INC-4821** | Hartford kiosk outage, with a screenshot attached about status-page access | #inc-vtg-hartford, 3 Aug 2026 (Gideon, 11:08) |
| **VT-55120** | Root-cause ticket for the Hartford kiosk outage, with Carrowmere's gateway finding and reconnect log attached | #inc-vtg-hartford, 14 Oct 2026 (Gideon) |

Two caveats before this goes to Mateo:
- **#8841 is inconsistent.** The sources describe it differently: browser cache on the Allentown kiosks, missed carrier check-ins at Allentown Gate 4, a kiosk timeout at Door 12, and Door 14 not selectable at Newark. They also disagree on whether it is open or closed. It may be one ticket reused for several issues, or the number may be wrong in places. Gideon or support should confirm before it goes in the history.
- **#PD-4418 is inferred.** The digest says "the account Nadia runs" and doesn't name Vantorre. I matched it to Vantorre Group because other digests call that "Nadia's industrial account".

I left out two tickets that belong to other accounts: #4812 (Vantorre Mobility, EV charger bays, Moss digest of 10 Mar 2025) and #PD-4402 (Quillfeather Outfitters).

Some digests mention Vantorre issues without a ticket number, such as the Door 14 duplicate arrivals (3 May 2026) and the Door 4 export filter (cheat sheet). I didn't list those.
